title: Pet Pickup
description: This plugin that I made over the weekend that allows users to pickup their pets in a portable spawn egg, for any purposes they desire ;D
body:
This plugin that I made over the weekend that allows users to pickup their pets in a portable spawn egg, which allows them to transfer their pets over potentially long distances, or even different dimensions, instead of transporting them manually; let's all be honest here, it's much easier to use a command and to right click your pet, and to place it somewhere else, than building a giant ice highway and hoping your pet doesn't die along the way.

Important detail: Make sure you use /pp to toggle on pet pickup mode, otherwise it won't work! OPs have the permission by default, but normal users will need a specific permission node, check below, I do recommend using a plugin such as LuckPerms to get the permission nodes working.

Permission nodes:

pp.toggle - Toggle Pet Pickup mode on or off.

pp.bypass.worldguard - Bypass WorldGuard restrictions

pp.bypass.whitelist - Bypass the entity type whitelist

pp.bypass.pickup - Bypass pet ownership protections.

Config options:

databaseType: The database type should be used to store the picked up entities.

databaseIP: The IP address to the configured database.

databasePort: The port to the configured database.

databaseName: The name of the configured database.

databasePassword: The password to the configured database.

whitelistedTypes: The entity types that are allowed to be picked up, under settings.yml

Messages can also be customised under PetPickup/lang.yml

The plugin respects ownership of pets, as well as WorldGuard regions, provided that it is installed.
